# Pull Request Template 

## Title
Use Conventional Commits format for the PR title, e.g. `feat(auth): add refresh token endpoint` or `fix(ui): prevent double submit`.

## Summary: What does this PR do?
- Short description of the change (what and why).

## Testing
- Unit Tests added/updated?
- Integration tested locally?
- How was it tested?

## How to test 
- Steps to reproduce or run locally. Include commands, sample requests, and expected results.

## Screenshots (for UI changes)
- Attach screenshots or short recordings demonstrating the change.

## Security & Secrets
- Confirm no secrets are committed in this PR (API keys, passwords, private certs). 
- If a secret was required during development, document how it was handled and rotated.

## AI / Copilot usage declaration
- Did you use AI assistance (GitHub Copilot) to produce code or text in this PR? Yes / No
- If Yes, state:
  - Where: Files or sections generated by AI
  - Human edits and validation performed: How did you verify the output?

## New Dependency Declaration
- New dependency/dependencies? Yes / No
- If Yes, state:
    - Why?
    - Any security considerations? -> Security scan result.

## Checklist (required)
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Branch name follows conventions (e.g. `feature/...`, `fix/...`, `chore/...`, `docs/...`)
- [ ] Description in this PR is clear and includes testing steps
- [ ] Linting/formatting run and passed locally (e.g., `npm run lint`, `ruff`, `black`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit/integration) and passing locally
- [ ] CI checks are green
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets added/committed 
- [ ] AI usage declared (if applicable) 
- [ ] AI-generated code is clearly identifiable with human review notes.

## Notes for reviewers
- Any additional context or areas that need careful review.
